programs.title: Gogglebox
programs.desc: The Goggleboxers check out Eurovision, Race Across the World, Dogs Behaving (Very) Badly, Jamie's Ultimate BBQ, Widow's Bay, Trading Places, Police Interceptors and the News.

programs.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
programs.desc: From Susie Dent to Miquita Oliver and Bez, what do our top celebs think of Cocaine Bear, Glastonbury and much more? Oh, and Ricky Tomlinson, Sue Johnston and Antiques Roadshow.

programs.title: First Dates
programs.desc: Two self-confessed nerds get together as engineer Ellie meets nuclear project manager Callum. Author Beckie meets poet Paul. And disco DJ John's love life's been stuck on pause..

programs.title: Taskmaster
programs.desc: Armando Iannucci and Joanna Page contemplate an alien invasion in the Taskmaster house. Joel Dommett enjoys putting things on things and Amy Gledhill performs sock-based stand-up.

programs.title: World's Biggest Curry Restaurant
programs.desc: What does it take to run the largest Pakistani Indian restaurant on Earth? We go behind the scenes of the Royal Nawaab in Greater Manchester to see how they deliver perfection at scale.

programs.title: Yorkshire by the Sea
programs.desc: Whitby distillers Jess and Luke create a tasty tipple from foraged seaside ingredients. And in Scarborough, pioneering sea-farmer Wave checks out his seaweed harvest of sugar kelp.
